_comment: Agents that stay at their published paths (Article XXIII: the path is a promise) but are
WITHHELD FROM EVERY LOOKUP because a live outside channel now carries the current version.
build_registry.py drops matching agents, their stacks and swarms from registry.json — and
since the store, the static API, match.json and brainstem discovery all read registry.json,
the copies go dark everywhere at once. Nothing is deleted; installers who already fetched a
path keep resolving it. The registry records the withheld COUNT and the rule, never the list.

rules.reason: RAR indexes the AIBAST Agents Library as an outside channel (sources.json); the hosted copies drifted from the library of record (104 hosted vs 72 upstream).
